genre.en: a street-culture and design magazine editorial: real city streets, confident, graphic, natural light

s: the shoes stand on a pale-concrete step against a muted sky-blue wall, hard afternoon sun throwing their sharp shadows long across the step
a pair of feet mid-stride in the shoes on a city crosswalk, low sun from behind, crisp long shadows, the street softly blurred
the shoes rest on a sage-green paper sweep, a shaft of hard window light falling across them and the floor
